\caption{\textbf{Closing the loop at 13 \nfe} (\flux, $\delta = 0.6$, $3.8\times$ fewer transformer evaluations than the 50-step reference). \seacache (our run of its released gate) reuses the last computed residual on skipped steps, \kalsea forecasts it, and \ours (\kalsea with \pcgs) also corrects each skipped gap once the next step is computed. Fixed selection rule: among the 182 of 200 held-out DrawBench prompts on which the three caches computed the same steps, those whose PSNR gain of \ours over \seacache is closest to the median (+1.17\,dB; left) and the upper quartile (+2.38\,dB; right).
